business_problem: FPT Smart Cloud needed to scale virtual-assistant deployments for customer service and workforce enablement while improving speech quality, reducing model-training time, and keeping inference efficient enough for millions of monthly interactions.
solution_summary: FPT Smart Cloud built its customer-service and workforce-assistance stack on NVIDIA GPUs so the same platform could power large-scale call-center automation and better speech synthesis models. FPT AI Engage handles high-volume virtual-agent workloads such as information inquiries, card self-service, surveys, debt collection, and service-to-sales flows, while FPT AI Mentor helps agents learn with AI-generated situational questions and answers. In production, the inference path is optimized with NVIDIA TensorRT and served through NVIDIA Triton Inference Server using dynamic batching. The company uses Kubernetes with NVIDIA GPU Operator and Multi-Instance GPU support to deploy virtual assistants at scale, while training moved from NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPUs toward NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs to reduce processing time and improve multilingual voice quality for 18 languages.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs
solution_components.role: Accelerate newer speech-synthesis and language-model training workloads with faster turnaround and higher voice quality.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA TensorRT
solution_components.role: Optimizes model inference so call-center and voice workloads can run efficiently at large scale.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
solution_components.role: Serves the optimized AI models behind FPT AI Engage and related virtual-agent workloads.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA GPU Operator

solution_components.name: Multi-Instance GPU

data_flow: Customer calls and agent-assist requests enter FPT AI Engage and FPT AI Mentor, where speech and language models are served through Triton and TensorRT-optimized inference. Kubernetes, GPU Operator, and MIG distribute those workloads across shared GPU infrastructure, while A100 and H100 systems train new multilingual speech and LLM models for ongoing quality improvements.
integration_points: Card self-service, surveys, debt collection, and telesales flows
business_outcome: FPT scaled Home Credit Vietnam from 5 million calls per month to 12 million peak-hour calls, cut operating costs by 50 percent, achieved a 98 percent call success rate, doubled service-to-sales volume, improved knowledge quality for agents by 55 percent, and shortened speech-model preparation from about 20 days to five days with H100-based training.
